steps.run: LOG=.github/logs/agent-activity.log; if [ -f "$LOG" ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" -gt 1048576 ]; then mv "$LOG" "${LOG}.old"; fi; SAFE=$(echo "${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); echo "[AGENT-START] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> "$LOG"

AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; case "$AGENT" in VarolMaksutoglu) TIER="Orchestrator"; ROLE="Teknik Koordinator"; EMOJI="D";; TanerYilmaz) TIER="T1 Principal"; ROLE="Bas Yazilim Mimari"; EMOJI="P1";; OyaKanat) TIER="T1 Principal"; ROLE="Kidemli Yazilim Mimari"; EMOJI="P1";; BarisBenli) TIER="T1.5 Staff Engineer"; ROLE="Kidemli Yazilim Muhendisi"; EMOJI="SE";; TarikZiyaYesilcimen) TIER="T1.5 Staff Engineer"; ROLE="Yazilim Muhendisi"; EMOJI="SE";; EnisSaitErken) TIER="T2 MidCoder"; ROLE="Yazilim Gelistirici"; EMOJI="MC";; SelinAkar) TIER="T2 MidCoder"; ROLE="Yazilim Gelistirici"; EMOJI="MC";; CananBirsen) TIER="T2.5 Lead Analyst"; ROLE="Kidemli Sistem Analisti"; EMOJI="LA";; EmreKilic) TIER="T3 Analyst"; ROLE="Sistem Analisti"; EMOJI="A3";; AyseDemir) TIER="T3 Analyst"; ROLE="Guvenlik ve Performans Analisti"; EMOJI="A3";; ElifOzgeMaksutoglu) TIER="T3 Analyst"; ROLE="Test ve Kalite Analisti"; EMOJI="A3";; *) TIER="Unknown"; ROLE="Unknown"; EMOJI="??";; esac; echo ""; echo "[$EMOJI] ======================================="; echo "[$EMOJI]  $AGENT — $ROLE"; echo "[$EMOJI]  Tier: $TIER"; echo "[$EMOJI]  Session: $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')"; echo "[$EMOJI] ======================================="; echo ""

if [ -f ".github/todo/active-plan.md" ]; then PLAN_STATUS=$(head -10 .github/todo/active-plan.md | grep 'status:' | head -1); if [ -n "$PLAN_STATUS" ]; then echo "[PLAN] Active plan detected: $PLAN_STATUS"; fi; fi

SESSION_COUNT=$(find .github/memory/sessions -name '*.md' ! -name '_*' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$SESSION_COUNT" -gt 20 ]; then echo "[SESSION-WARNING] $SESSION_COUNT sessions found (limit: 20). Archiving recommended."; fi

mkdir -p .github/logs; SAFE=$(echo "${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); printf '%s
%s
%s
' "[AGENT-STOP] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" '---' "[SESSION-MARKER] agent=$SAFE stopped at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'). Check .github/memory/sessions/ for session file." >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log
mkdir -p .github/logs; SAFE=$(echo "${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); echo "[AGENT-ERROR] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log
